review_method: Fresh Blender 4.5.14 LTS CPU-only reopen. Compare every tagged collection instance with its declared library collection/source, measure instance transforms against asset rules and disclosed host exceptions, compare actual library set to exact asset pins, resolve all relative links, then verify source SHA unchanged. No render or model save.
visual_scaling_policy: Named botanical ranges follow their manifests. Generic non-species grass/sage clumps retain deliberate host natural variation: landscape clumps 0.8–1.25, courtyard grass 0.75. This follows common.shared_assets.place natural plant variation guidance, but is explicitly not represented as a numeric permission in the legacy asset manifests.
bespoke_exceptions: Twin-gable dimensions, steel framing assumptions, triangular glazing, roof/wall junctions and continuous counters/slabs follow this home layout.

Repeated vertical post appearance proxies are local solid wood-look finish geometry; they are not hollow fabricated steel-cover assemblies. Actual shared hollow U-covers are used for the 34 pitched rafter/ridge members.
Site-specific terrain, driveway and slab/paving perimeter cuts are local; full pavers and planting are shared linked collections.
